cite.text: Fusemachines Inc. · S-1 filed Oct 6, 2026 · Six months ended Jun 30, 2026

analysis: Revenue was $3.7M in H1 2026, down 8% year over year.

Gross margin was 52.0%, down 5.5 points from H1 2025. Operating costs exceeded revenue by $5.7M, an operating margin of -155.9%. Operating expenses grew 71% against revenue growth of -8%. The fastest-growing cost line was Research & development (+82%). The period ended with a net loss of $3.7M. Non-operating items added $2.0M, -54% of pre-tax earnings, so the bottom line overstates operating performance.

Operating cash flow was −$3.5M. Non-cash charges added back $50K of depreciation and amortization and $878K of share-based compensation. Working capital and other items used $718K. Capital expenditures of $27K exceeded it, leaving free cash flow of −$3.5M.
